title: Mawdeep: what the beast-folk did
changes: Each chamber of the Mawdeep now shows what it was used for: cages where villagers were kept, a butchery of meat hooks and blocks, the skinning floor with its flaying frames, and the stitching room where hides are sewn onto the living.
Blood smears run along the tunnels where victims were dragged from the cages to the torture rooms. What was left of them lies in the midden and the elites' lairs.
Fixed an error when some beast-folk moves landed.
